Weekend speech fed

Speaker: Jerome Powell

Economic outlook

Real GDP is projected to grow by 1.8% in 2026 and by 1.6% in 2027.

Inflation

Inflation is projected to average 2.1% in 2026.

Labour market

The unemployment rate is projected to average 3.8% in 2026.

Financial stability

Financial conditions remained tight and monetary policy transmission continued to function smoothly.

Monetary policy

The Federal Reserve decided to keep its policy interest rate at its current level.

The Committee will be patient, and future policy decisions will depend on incoming data.

Risks

Risks to inflation were broadly balanced.
